rules_of_origin.summary: Origin is set by The Customs (Origin of Chargeable Goods: Developing Countries Trading Scheme) Regulations 2023 (version 2023 No. 557, 19 June 2023). A preference is claimed with a proof of origin listed by the scheme; without one the third-country duty applies.

agreements.title: COMPREHENSIVE ECONOMIC AND TRADE AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE GOVERNMENT OF THE UNITED KINGDOM OF GREAT BRITAIN AND NORTHERN IRELAND AND THE GOVERNMENT OF THE REPUBLIC OF INDIA

rules_of_origin.summary: Origin is set by Origin Reference Document implementing the Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement between the Government of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland and the Government of the Republic of India signed on 24 July 2025 (“the India Origin Reference Document”) (version 1.0, 13 January 2026). A preference is claimed with a proof of origin listed by the scheme; without one the third-country duty applies.
